description: ADO read of the r-wire-dao cells (read-only ACE OLE DB connection): for each column of W a client static read-only recordset of SELECT ID, column FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN base AND base+99 ORDER BY ID; Field Name, Type, DefinedSize, Precision, NumericScale and Attributes, then GetRows(adGetRowsRest).
